text:
HARDLY SURPRISING...
Always pushing yourself
too hard...
Don't worry.
Just passed out...
What a troublesome
teacher...
When I woke up,
I was in bed...
My whole body felt so heavy
it hardly seemed
to belong to me...
I knew why.
I had called the sword back
in that reckless way, then used
all that power at once.
And then...
there was Ishlar...
Outside the window, it was raining.
In the darkness, all I could hear
was the steady rush of rain.
I couldn't bear it
and turned away. Just then,
I heard
a soft knock...
When I woke up,
I was in bed...
My whole body ached
as though it no longer
belonged to me...
I knew why.
I had called the sword back
in that reckless way, then used
all that power at once...
But I didn't regret it.
What troubled me
was Ishlar...
Why had he...?
Heavy rain fell outside the window.
As I listened
and turned things over in my mind,
I heard
a soft knock...
